relevance_note: A PRISMA systematic review of ALPS-like disorders across 24 genes in which TNFAIP3 appears only as an aggregate Table 1 column and in group statements (e.g. "Skin involvement was remarkable in TNFAIP3 and ADA2 deficiencies"), with no patient-level clinical or variant data.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown file by hand; no script transcribed any table. The only TNFAIP3 content is a gene-level summary column in Table 1 (inheritance 'AD LOF', lymphoproliferation 'S, H, L', autoimmunity 'Cytopenia', associated features, ALPS parameters, treatment) and group-level sentences in Results; no individual TNFAIP3 patient, variant or per-person phenotype is given, so only the publications row is filled. The per-gene patient counts and source lists are in Supplementary Tables 1-2 and Figure 1A, which are not in this file. The patients whose functional assays are shown (Figures 4-7, authors' laboratories) have defects in other genes, not TNFAIP3. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is set true because the review's patients are by design taken from earlier publications; prior_report_citation gives the two references the text attaches to TNFAIP3 patients ('TNFAIP3 (62, 85)' for DNT values; ref 62 also cited for viral infection susceptibility in 'TET2, TPP2 and TNFAIP3 patients (27, 61, 62)'); this may be incomplete because the full source list is in the supplement. No internal contradictions found.

study_type.span: The literature search was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-analyses (PRISMA) guidelines (34).

cites_prior_report_of_same_patients.span: All types of publications reporting patients, in English or in Spanish, published until October 26, 2020, were collected and total of reported patients were counted
